verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Cognee ingests text, files, URLs, JSON-like data and business integrations (Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Google Drive) into a knowledge graph via .remember/.improve, not just chat transcripts, and this is corroborated by the llms.txt probe describing Cognee as turning 'documents, code, and application data' into persistent memory. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of ingesting arbitrary JSON/business data formats beyond vendor docs, and no benchmark/demo specifically testing non-chat data ingestion.
